title: AVOLITE — lighter, more refined
question: New directions with light surfaces, stronger typography and more polished diagrams. Choose a direction or describe a revision.

options.label: Engineering Folio
options.thesis: A bright technical folio with precise diagrams, sage chapter fields and a quiet evidence appendix.
options.viewport: Large typography and a horizontal foldout system drawing, followed by a deep-green evidence chapter.
options.risk: Needs strong diagram craft to avoid feeling like a document template.

raised.raise: Attach source and scope beside every claim, not in a distant footer.
Keep broad surfaces bright and confine accents to functional highlights.
Keep diagram scale and label positions stable when stages change.
Use direct diagram labels and bounded detail views without ornamental geometry.
Distinguish selected and pending stages through shape and words.
Freeze all surrounding activity while a technical passage is being read.

options.label: Review Pavilion
options.thesis: Porcelain-white reading space meets a bold cobalt system plane and restrained exhibit captions.
options.viewport: An oversized two-line headline, an open system diagram and a confident cobalt evidence band.
options.risk: Architectural presentation is familiar; responsive diagram quality must deliver the distinction.

options.label: Provenance Ribbon
options.thesis: Trace each claim through a single evidence ribbon.
options.viewport: Trace each claim through a single evidence ribbon.
options.risk: The historical custody metaphor adds work for engineering judges.
options.case: Less immediate audience identification and lower explanation clarity than Engineering Folio.

options.label: Iridescent Edge
options.thesis: An airy surface with narrowly colored signal edges.
options.viewport: An airy surface with narrowly colored signal edges.
options.risk: Atmosphere can overwhelm the system explanation.
options.case: Less immediate audience identification and lower explanation clarity than Engineering Folio.

options.label: Registered Plates
options.thesis: Compare system stages in precisely aligned panels.
options.viewport: Compare system stages in precisely aligned panels.
options.risk: Biological stage imagery weakens audience identification and flow clarity.
options.case: Less immediate audience identification and lower explanation clarity than Engineering Folio.

options.label: Technical Drawing Sheet
options.thesis: Link numbered system parts to a formal specification.
options.viewport: Link numbered system parts to a formal specification.
options.risk: Patent-style numerals slow the story and may suggest a legal status the project does not claim.
options.case: Less immediate audience identification and lower explanation clarity than Engineering Folio.

options.label: Emission Rail
options.thesis: Navigate stages along one calibrated rail.
options.viewport: Navigate stages along one calibrated rail.
options.risk: A single-size instrument grammar underplays the story and overwhelms judges with instrumentation.
options.case: Less immediate audience identification and lower explanation clarity than Engineering Folio.

options.label: Layered Scroller
options.thesis: Bring the selected text plane forward.
options.viewport: Bring the selected text plane forward.
options.risk: Bitmap hierarchy and depth navigation distract from technical reading.
options.case: Less immediate audience identification and lower explanation clarity than Engineering Folio.

canonCard.label: Precision Light
canonCard.thesis: A polished light engineering site with familiar navigation, balanced spacing and restrained blue accents.
canonCard.viewport: Clear left headline and a technical diagram plate, with an open evidence index below.
canonCard.risk: Easy to use but closest to a conventional technical website.
